title: kbmon's kb panel counts closed and non-UNK gap entries and resolved conflicts as open
goal: the kb panel's gaps figure counts the open gaps by the rule kbfacts and bench_pool use (an [UNK entry with no settling line), and its conflicts figure leaves out resolved entries

run:
import json,os,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile,time
def k(*a,env=None):
    t0=time.time();p=s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/kbmon.py',*a],capture_output=True,text=True,env=env or os.environ,timeout=120);p.wall=time.time()-t0
    if p.returncode not in (0,1): print('kbmon exit',p.returncode,p.stderr[-300:]);sys.exit(1)
    return p
sys.path.insert(0,'_tools')
import kbfacts,kbcommon as c
e=kbfacts.ledger_entries(c.GAPS);want=sum('[UNK' in x['text'] and not kbfacts.OPEN_GAP.search(x['text']) for x in e)
got=json.loads(k('--json','--panel','kb').stdout)['panels']['kb']['data']['gaps']
print('panel',got,'rule',want);sys.exit(0 if got==want else 1)
